goal: Add the smallest complete Codex conversation design checkpoint: detect interface intent, obtain a bounded advisory Codex design brief, require user confirmation in the active Codex task, and preserve the reviewed Provider generation and delivery route.
acceptance_criteria: Interface and visual-redesign requests record the Codex conversation surface, generated-project UI constraints, direct screenshot/video evidence, and a user design-confirmation checkpoint.
A bounded, redacted, hashed CGKNCodexCapabilityEscalation is written to per-chat support state and recorded in agent_session.
When explicitly enabled, local codex.exe runs in ephemeral read-only mode and its draft is validated into an advisory brief before whiteboard projection.
Pending or unavailable Codex supervision remains visible as workflow state and never silently becomes an approved design.
Generation cannot start while required design supervision or user design confirmation is pending.
Design confirmation and follow-up input re-enter the same Codex conversation intake path without a secondary messaging surface.
Non-visual short requests do not acquire interface scope or a Codex design checkpoint.
Provider output validation, post-build finalization, local_packager, public_delivery_gate, and delivery_manifest remain the only Codex conversation generation and delivery route.

quality_metrics.measure: bounded design-supervision usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: all prepared requests and completed briefs validate; no supervisor artifact has candidate, evidence, package, or delivery authority
quality_metrics.method: deterministic adapter tests plus Codex supervisor contract tests

quality_metrics.target: visual Codex conversation products freeze interaction surfaces, mobile-first/theme/accessibility requirements, and screenshot/video acceptance before generation
quality_metrics.method: whiteboard contract tests and Codex conversation message-path integration tests

quality_metrics.measure: formal Provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and Provider route guards pass without a second generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: kernel contract and formal Provider regression tests

quality_metrics.measure: changed Codex conversation design capability tests

prevention: Keep design detection and Codex handoff in a dedicated adapter; make only narrow Codex conversation intake and start-policy changes.
assurance: Review every new state field as workflow/support state rather than formal evidence.
Review the diff against the Codex conversation mainline and Codex authority contracts.
control: Run adapter, Codex conversation intake, Codex supervisor, and kernel contract tests.
Run a live read-only Codex smoke test only if it does not create or alter generated candidates.
improvement: Record whether design-first routing avoids the prior CLI-only scope error without increasing short-request complexity.

interface_expectations: analyze_design_intent(text, whiteboard) returns a deterministic support-state update without starting generation.
prepare_design_escalation(session_dir, conversation_id, session) writes only bounded per-conversation support artifacts and agent_session events.
A validated design brief is projected into whiteboard support state with advisory_only true and requires explicit user confirmation.
CodexConversation.send_message presents the design checkpoint in the active Codex task.
User confirmation is normalized to one conversation turn and then follows handle_text.

feedback: The design checkpoint, bounded read-only Codex supervision, explicit user approval gate, and unchanged Provider delivery route passed deterministic and full-repository verification. A real Codex CLI smoke produced a valid advisory brief. The secondary messaging entry was later retired by ITER-051.

worked: Separating one-function business scope from product interaction scope kept short requests minimal while correctly routing GUI requests through design confirmation.
Reusing the existing capability-supervisor seal and Provider revalidation preserved authority boundaries instead of adding a second generation path.
did_not_work: The first full regression exposed that the new test filename required the repository's Codex conversation profile marker; the actual runtime and design assertions were not failing.
experiments: Verify design confirmation and artifact presentation directly in the active Codex task.
